name: Acute Arterial Hypoxemia
clinicalReferenceThreshold: Clinical Reference: Normal arterial blood oxygen saturation is >= 95%; clinical hypoxemia is defined as SpO2 < 90% (aerospace clinical medicine guidelines). NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F §6.2.1.2 defines inspired ambient oxygen partial pressure (pO2: 19.5–23.1 kPa), not blood SpO2.
demonstrationThreshold: Project Prototype Design Choice: SpO2 < 92.0% for >= 2 consecutive readings is an illustrative engineering demonstration alert trigger, not an official NASA or FAA standard threshold, nor a clinical diagnosis or validated flight rule.
missingDataBehavior: If SpO2 is missing or non-numeric, flags INSUFFICIENT_DATA and suppresses rule evaluation.
dataQualityCheck: Evaluates PPG perfusion index (PI > 0.5%) and correlates with respiratory rate elevation to exclude probe disconnect.
rationale: Arterial oxygen desaturation indicates compromised suit/cabin oxygen supply, gas contamination, or impaired pulmonary ventilation.
cautiousNextStep: Illustrative Demo Checklist: Verify pulse oximeter fit and suit umbilical connection. Do not rely on software alerts for clinical diagnosis; consult Crew Medical Officer and follow mission-approved checklist.
escalationGuidance: Illustrative Escalation: Alert Flight Surgeon and EVA buddy per mission flight rules for medical evaluation.
scientificSource: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F §6.2.1.2 (Ambient Inspired pO2 limits: 19.5–23.1 kPa); FAA Civil Aerospace Medical Institute Hypoxia Training Concepts (general physiology context); Standard Clinical Pulse Oximetry Guidelines.

name: Sustained Resting Tachycardia
clinicalReferenceThreshold: Clinical Reference: Resting heart rate > 100 bpm defines sinus tachycardia per NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.1.
demonstrationThreshold: Project Demonstration Trigger: Resting heart rate > 115 bpm with zero workload for >= 15 seconds.
missingDataBehavior: If HR is null, flags 'Sensor Disconnected / Reposition Lead-II Electrode'.
dataQualityCheck: Inspects Lead-II R-R interval consistency to differentiate true sinus tachycardia from muscle EMG motion artifact.
rationale: Non-exertional tachycardia in microgravity may signify hypovolemia, autonomic dysregulation, thermal strain, or infection.
cautiousNextStep: Illustrative Demo Checklist: Cease high-exertion activity, verify bioharness contact, rehydrate according to mission plan, and follow clinical rest protocols.
escalationGuidance: Illustrative Escalation: Notify Crew Medical Officer if resting heart rate remains elevated.

name: Cabin Atmospheric Hypercapnia
clinicalReferenceThreshold: Clinical Reference: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F §6.2.1.3 nominal 24-hr average cabin pCO2 limit <= 3.00 mmHg (400 Pa / approx 0.39% vol @ 760 mmHg). (Earlier standard editions cited §6.2.2).
demonstrationThreshold: Project Demonstration Trigger: Modeled cabin pCO2 > 3.00 mmHg (0.39% vol @ 760 mmHg) on a 30-second rolling average.
missingDataBehavior: Defaults cabin pressure to 760 mmHg with an explicit baseline assumption note.
dataQualityCheck: Cross-verifies primary and redundant non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) carbon dioxide sensors.
rationale: Elevated CO2 in microgravity induces cerebral vasodilation, cephalic congestion, headaches, and visual discomfort.
cautiousNextStep: Illustrative Demo Checklist: Inspect compartment ventilation and verify environmental life-support telemetry per standard operating procedures.
escalationGuidance: Illustrative Escalation: Coordinate with Mission Control flight controllers to evaluate scrubber performance.
scientificSource: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F §6.2.1.3 (Inspired Partial Pressure of CO2); Law et al. (2014).

name: High-Flux Ionizing Radiation Event
clinicalReferenceThreshold: Clinical Reference: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.4 (Space Permissible Exposure Limits, ALARA principle) and Vol 2 Rev F §11.1 (Ionizing Radiation dosimetric monitoring & solar particle event protection).
demonstrationThreshold: Project Demonstration Trigger: Instantaneous dosimeter flux > 5.00 mSv/day.
missingDataBehavior: Flags sensor blackout, alerts crew to inspect physical dosimeters.
dataQualityCheck: Correlates silicon detector rates with external solar particle event magnetometer channels.
rationale: Solar Particle Events generate fluxes of energetic protons, risking acute radiation syndrome and hematopoietic suppression.
cautiousNextStep: Illustrative Demo Checklist: Prepare to muster in shielded storm shelter compartment according to flight rules and verify dosimeter readings.
escalationGuidance: Illustrative Escalation: Consult Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) for trajectory projections and biodosimetry guidance.
scientificSource: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.4 & Vol 2 Rev F §11.1; Cucinotta et al. (2013).

name: SANS Cephalad Fluid Redistribution & Optic Sheath Expansion
condition: ONSD > 5.80 mm OR acute dilation > 0.5 mm above pre-flight baseline
clinicalReferenceThreshold: Clinical Reference: Optic Nerve Sheath Diameter (ONSD) > 5.8 mm indicates elevated intracranial pressure in terrestrial medicine; research reference for spaceflight neuro-ocular syndrome (Lee et al. 2020).
demonstrationThreshold: Project Demonstration Trigger (Illustrative): ONSD > 5.80 mm or acute shift > 0.5 mm above pre-flight baseline.
missingDataBehavior: Classified as NOT_MEASURED; no speculative alert generated.
dataQualityCheck: Requires verification that ultrasound probe is perpendicular to optic nerve axis 3 mm behind retina.
rationale: Cephalad fluid redistribution elevates retrobulbar venous pressure, contributing to disc edema and hyperopic shifts.
cautiousNextStep: Illustrative Demo Checklist: Perform scheduled research ophthalmic ultrasound checklist; consider mission-approved LBNP research session if indicated by flight surgeons.
escalationGuidance: Illustrative Escalation: Transmit ocular ultrasound and OCT scans to flight surgeon telemedicine queue.
scientificSource: NASA Human Research Program SANS Evidence Report; Lee et al. (2020).

name: Paroxysmal Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia
condition: heart_rate > 150 bpm AND sudden onset (delta HR > 50 bpm within 3s) AND workload == 0
clinicalReferenceThreshold: Clinical Reference: AHA/ACC electrophysiology criteria for wide-complex ventricular tachycardia; PhysioNet MIT-BIH morphological waveforms cited as research reference.
demonstrationThreshold: Project Demonstration Trigger (Illustrative): HR > 150 bpm with rapid onset at zero workload.
missingDataBehavior: Requires at least 3 consecutive anomalous QRS complexes before critical trigger.
dataQualityCheck: Analyzes Lead-II baseline noise; confirms absence of preceding exertional work telemetry.
rationale: Ventricular tachyarrhythmia diminishes stroke volume and organ perfusion; requires prompt clinical response.
cautiousNextStep: Illustrative Demo Checklist: Assist subject into a safe rest position, verify lead attachments, and initiate standard cardiac monitoring protocol.
escalationGuidance: Illustrative Escalation: Immediate urgent notification to Crew Medical Officer and flight surgeons.
scientificSource: Synthetic arrhythmia-inspired demonstration using morphological principles from PhysioNet MIT-BIH research waveforms (#208); NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.1.

name: Sensor & Telemetry Data Quality Verification
acceptedUnits: ISO / MET timestamp, valid numeric values
condition: Detects missing required columns, non-numeric values, out-of-order timestamps, duplicate timestamps, or impossible physical readings (e.g. SpO2 > 100% or < 40%, HR < 20 or > 260)
clinicalReferenceThreshold: Engineering & Regulatory Reference: FDA Clinical Decision Support Software Guidance & GMLP data integrity standards.
demonstrationThreshold: Project Demonstration Trigger: Missing columns, impossible physiological values, or corrupted timestamps.
missingDataBehavior: Marks data status as 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA_FOR_INTERPRETATION' and halts clinical scoring.
rationale: Clinical decision algorithms must not generate confident diagnostic conclusions from corrupt, truncated, or noisy telemetry.
cautiousNextStep: Illustrative Demo Checklist: Inspect sensor placement, verify electrode adhesion, and re-seat telemetry harness connections.
escalationGuidance: Illustrative Escalation: Switch to secondary redundant biomedical sensor harness if data corruption persists.
scientificSource: Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP) & FDA Guidance for Clinical Decision Support Software.
